CODE 
Art. 2.3.76. 
Early liquidation 
If the management of his or her assets by one of the spouses is such as to compromise the rights of the other spouse with regard to the calculation of the participation claim, the latter may request early liquidation of the participation claim. This is the case in particular in cases which lead to the notional meeting referred to in Article 2.3.68, ¤ 2.
  As from the final decision granting the request, the spouses are placed under the regime of separation as to property.
